query: Can capital expenses for volunteer purposes be deducted from income?

cands.text: An S-corp doesn't pay income tax -- taxation is pass-through.  This being the case, there are no tax deductions it could take for charitable giving.  The solution would be for you to make the contribution out of your own pocket and then personally claim the deduction on your own taxes.
